name: text-edit
title: Text Edit
description: A Tiptap markdown-first rich-text editor in the shared prose typography — toolbar levels that set the schema, bubble menu, link popover, task lists, tables, code blocks, markdown input rules and paste, onSave/onCancel, autosave, and a borderless ghost variant.

meta.whenToUse: Comments, notes, summaries and documents stored as Markdown (format="markdown") or HTML; in-place editing of a MarkdownView with variant="ghost".
meta.whenNotToUse: Plain single-line input (Input) or collaborative real-time docs (deferred text-edit-collab).
